title: Same Day Taj Mahal Tour by Car from Delhi
summary: See the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort in one day from Delhi: private AC car, private English-speaking guide and hotel pickup.
highlights: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort & local crafts

itinerary.title: Delhi → Agra by car
itinerary.description: Pickup from your hotel in New Delhi / Gurgaon; drive via the Yamuna Expressway, reaching Agra in about 3 hours.

itinerary.title: Visit the Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: Explore one of the Seven Wonders of the World with your private guide.

itinerary.title: Visit Agra Fort
itinerary.description: The magnificent red-sandstone fort on the banks of the Yamuna.

itinerary.title: Local arts & crafts
itinerary.description: Agra's famous marble inlay, carpet weaving and zardozi work.

itinerary.title: Drive back to Delhi
itinerary.description: Return via the Yamuna Expressway and transfer to your hotel.

note: The Taj Mahal remains closed on Fridays.

importantInfo.title: Booking & payment
importantInfo.body: Reserve now, pay later: book with a 15% advance deposit and pay the balance during the tour, or choose pay on arrival. Accepted: cash on arrival, credit card or PayPal.

importantInfo.title: Cancellation
importantInfo.body: Same-day excursions can be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

importantInfo.title: Pickup & drop-off
importantInfo.body: Any hotel in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon or the surrounding region, as well as Delhi airport. Please share your pickup location when booking.

importantInfo.title: Private tour
importantInfo.body: Only your group participates, with a dedicated AC vehicle, driver and guide.

importantInfo.title: Guide languages
importantInfo.body: Live guides are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Russian and Japanese.
